IncidentBot: :rotating_light: ALERT gpu-prod-eu at 99% GPU util, HPA reporting 'no data' for gpu-infer-hpa. Paging oncall julia. incident=INC-2026-6790123456

julia: picking up — I'm oncall. seeing grow in queue for /v1/stream and PODs Pending with reason: Insufficient GPUs.

omar: i'm online. any recent deploys to monitoring or infra?

julia: checked deploys — nothing in last 2h. prometheus shows scrape backlog and metrics-server CPU spikes. prom-adapter logs show:```
E0503 03:21:17 adapter.go:188] failed to query prometheus: context deadline exceeded
E0503 03:21:20 adapter.go:188] protobuf: read tcp 10.0.8.9:9090: i/o timeout
```

ben: that pattern usually from prometheus getting OOMKilled or retention job hammering it. can we confirm prom pods status?

julia: prom pod restarted twice in last 30m — reason OOMKilled. persistent disk i/o also high. metrics-server shows elevated scrape latency.

omar: immediate mitigation plan: 1) protect inference by cordoning/gently draining a few lower-priority nodepools; 2) patch HPA to a temporary fixed minReplicas=6; 3) scale gpu nodepool with emergency burst; 4) restart prometheus with throttled retention job.

julia: executing step 2 and 1 now.```bash
kubectl patch hpa gpu-infer-hpa -n inference --type='merge' -p '{"spec": {"minReplicas": 6}}'
kubectl cordon nodepool-noncritical-1 || true
kubectl drain node/node-spot-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=30 || true
```

ops-bot: :white_check_mark: HPA patched, minReplicas=6. Node node-spot-12 drain started.

cs-team-bot: customer impact: EU customers reporting 502s on heavy payloads, some retries causing duplicate billing concerns. notifying accounts: delta-ai, dataflowlabs.

ben: i'll restart prometheus with retention throttling. applying patch to cronjob that runs compaction/retention to reduce concurrency. also bump prom-adapter replicas from 2 -> 4 to absorb latency.```bash
kubectl scale deployment prometheus-adapter -n monitoring --replicas=4
kubectl patch cronjob prom-retention -n monitoring -p '{"spec": {"concurrencyPolicy": "Forbid"}}'
kubectl rollout restart deployment prometheus -n monitoring
```

infra-bot: nodepool scale request submitted: gpu-eu-burst desired=3 ETA ~4m.

julia: after HPA patch queues dropped ~30% within 90s. some jobs still pending due to node scarcity.

omar: note: HPA showing previously 'no data' due to adapter returning 204 responses when prom timed out; adapter aggregated failures and didn't present stale cached values. we should add adapter-side caching of last-known metric for short window.

ben: confirmed: prometheus pod OOM was triggered by stale retention snapshot job that previously ran unconstrained at midnight. fix: throttle retention and add resource limits, also enable pprof on prom for diagnosis.

julia: customers are reporting improved latencies. we'll keep oncall watch. handing handoff to omar for next 2h. i'm available if needed.

omar: taking handoff. will watch alerts: gpu-util > 85%, hpa:NoMetrics, prom-adapter errors. setting pager window to 10m intervals.

ops-bot: :white_check_mark: Nodepool scaling completed, 3 new GPU nodes added. pods scheduling on new nodes.

ben: followups to action: - add backpressure on retention job - add resource requests/limits and livenessProbe to prometheus - implement prom-adapter in-proc short-term cache (30s) - HPA fallback policy: prefer external metric if prom missing - run load test to validate burst capacity 

cs-team-bot: impact summary: window ~03:21-03:37 UTC. ~12% EU traffic impacted, error spike to 3.5% on heavy endpoints. key tenants flagged. recommend outreach + credit.

julia: documenting timeline for postmortem: 03:20 alert -> 03:22 HPA no-data -> 03:23 patch minReplicas -> 03:24 cordon/evict low-priority -> 03:25 scale prom-adapter -> 03:27 prometheus restart -> 03:31 nodepool provision complete -> 03:36 metrics recovered and HPA resumed.

omar: preliminary root cause: unthrottled retention snapshot job caused prom OOM -> prom restarted -> prom-adapter timeouts -> HPA lost metrics -> autoscaler didn't ramp replicas -> GPU pool saturated and queue grew.

ben: i'll own infra fixes. julia please own immediate runbook updates for oncall (how to patch hpa, where to scale nodes, how to throttle retention). omar please own adapter caching PR. caroline from cs will handle outbound comms. tagging @infra @eng-oncall @cs.

IncidentBot: :lock: Incident INC-2026-6790123456 mitigated -> monitoring. severity=sev2. postmortem_owner=ben.

julia: nice work team. we'll capture actions and close the loop in postmortem. :thumbsup:
